purpose: Separate concrete feature-moment data, proved complement vanishing, and the still-pending evaluation identity.

nodes.title: The support feature span and weighted feature moment
nodes.statement_tex: For any measure $\mu$, let $V=\operatorname{span}(\Phi_N(\operatorname{supp}\mu))$. Define the continuous linear form $L_s=I(s)^{-1}\int e^{-s\|z\|^2}\langle\Phi_N(z),A(s)(\cdot)\rangle\,d\mu(z)$ by the total operator-valued Bochner integral.
nodes.status_note: Concrete definitions contain no placeholder or choice from an unfinished existence assertion.

nodes.title: Weighted feature moments vanish on the weighted complement
nodes.statement_tex: For every measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb R^n$, every natural $N$, every real $s$, and every $u$ such that $A(s)u\in\operatorname{span}(\Phi_N(\operatorname{supp}\mu))^\perp$, the feature moment satisfies $L_s(u)=0$. The original unit-uniform, positive-parameter statement is retained as a wrapper.
hypotheses: No uniformity, regularity, growth, or positive-parameter hypothesis is needed for the stronger assertion.
nodes.proof_sketch_tex: The support of every Euclidean measure is conull. At a support point its feature belongs to the support feature span, so orthogonality makes the evaluated operator kernel vanish. Apply the generic integral-kernel lemma and scalar normalization.
nodes.status_note: Exact strong proof passed local kernel check with standard axioms; canonical integration awaits CI.

nodes.title: Evaluation of the feature moment on a feature
nodes.statement_tex: For a unit $m$-uniform measure with $m>0$, every natural $N$, $s>0$, and $x\in\mathbb R^n$, $L_s(\Phi_N(x))=\sum_{k=1}^N b_{k,s}(x,\ldots,x)$.
nodes.status_note: Canonical statement compiled; evaluation proof remains unfinished.

lem:moment-feature-remainder.reason: The supplied-L remainder uses evaluation; complement vanishing enters the later reconstruction through the analytic projection.
